derived: REGN turned 27.89% of revenue into free cash over 2023 to 2025 against the 36.1% its filed expense lines leave. Restated before interest: REGN paid $167mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 0.40% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 9.20% to 8.79%. Restated at replacement capex: REGN spent $2,373mm on plant over 2023 to 2025 against $1,048mm of depreciation and amortisation less amortisation of intangibles, 3.18% of revenue above what keeps the plant running. Taken at depreciation, the charge falls from 8.79% to 5.24%. Restated without one-off cash: REGN's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried $411mm of deal payments in operating cash flow, capital allocation whose assets the book values separately. None recurs, so the charge falls from 5.24% to 4.25%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 REGN's cash flow statement shows receivables up $395mm, inventories up $1,167mm, payables and accrued liabilities up $2,070mm, a working capital release of $509mm, 1.22% of revenue. A release flatters the window once and does not recur, so the charge rises from 4.25% to 5.62%. Rebuilt on the book's own ratios on 0.4039 of the revenue they are struck on, against 0.3477 the filings leave as cash over 2023 to 2025 (free cash flow before interest, at replacement capex, without one-off cash and without working capital build), so the charge is 5.6184%.

column11: bounded by two measured rates. Ceiling: Eliquis took 1,333,580 new Part D starts in 2024 (4,424,796 beneficiaries less 3,927,848 carried at 21.3% discontinuation), 23.85% of the 5,591,500 eligible pool. Floor: Savaysa, the last genuinely new anticoagulant to enter atrial fibrillation, peaked at 2,452 Part D beneficiaries in 2020 and fell every year to 1,536 in 2024, 0.044% of the same pool. 0.03 is a judgement at 0.126x the Eliquis capture and 68x the Savaysa floor, held level with milvexian because the pool, the incumbent and the displacement problem are identical
column12: this is generous rather than conservative and survives only because it is already the book's floor. ROXI-EVEREST has no placebo arm: NCT07626411 carries two arm groups, REGN7508 plus placebo and apixaban plus placebo, which is a double-dummy blind against an active comparator, so a win is the non-inferiority-plus-bleeding claim Savaysa lost with. Apixaban is generic from April 2028 and prescribers do not switch stable anticoagulated patients
